<translate>
'''Sacred Water''' is a relic that '''permanently multiplies all your stats by ×1.1''' when you drink it. It works '''once per character'''.
</translate>

<translate>
== Getting it ==

It is the reward of Korin's quest '''The Sacred Water''' ([[Special:MyLanguage/Classic Saga|Classic Saga]] quest 19): climb to [[Special:MyLanguage/Kami's Lookout|Kami's Lookout]] and hand [[Special:MyLanguage/Korin|Korin]] a Water Bucket. The quest also rewards a Red, a Green and a Blue [[Special:MyLanguage/Capsules|Capsule]].
</translate>

<translate>
== Effect ==

* Drinking it multiplies all your stats by ×1.1 by default.
* It only works once per character: if you have already drunk it, nothing happens.
* The bonus survives death. Only a character reset clears it.
</translate>
